newsitem.title: EGYPT: Heliopolis Housing Q3 96/7 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Heliopolis Housing Q3 96/7 profits up.

text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development said on Tuesday it made profits of 67.6 million pounds in the first nine months of 1996/7 compared to 58.1 million in the same year ago period.
The financial year begins on July 1.
In a published advertisement, the firm also forecast a 14 pound dividend for each of its 4,944,760 shares for financial 1996/7, compared to 10.9 pounds for 1995/6.
Earlier this month, Heliopolis Housing chairman said the firm made net after-tax profits of 57.7 million in the first seven months of the financial year.
Managing Director Fadel el-Shehawi was also quoted as saying the state would privatise a further five percent of the equity in the real estate company soon. He gave no other details of the sale.
The state has so far sold 27.14 percent of the company, including 10 percent to the employees' association. The Holding Company retains a majority 72.86 percent.
